de-02.label: Project context
de-02.content:
# HOL project conventions

Use Plan before multi-step changes. Read the generated lab-config.json for the approved database, schema, role and warehouse. Never infer that an existing connection is the intended account.

- Only synthetic SOURCE tables may be read; only the participant's allocated schema may be written.
- Use uppercase descriptive Snowflake identifiers and explicit column lists.
- Parameterize business cutoffs; use bound values or validated identifiers, never raw user text in SQL.
- Net spend in this simulated lab means SUM(AMOUNT) for COMPLETED transactions; canceled/refunded rows contribute zero.
- Preview edits/SQL and validate results against expected-results.json.
- Report evidence, not guessed performance improvements. No production access or permission changes.
- Keep secrets and private participant rosters out of source and reports.
- Publishing, email, schedules and cleanup require separate approval.

de-03.content:

# Deployment review

1. Read the target code and project AGENTS.md. Do not execute or edit.
2. Load [naming](resources/naming.md), [performance](resources/performance.md), and [parameterization](resources/parameterization.md).
3. Confirm exact sandbox scope, output grain, business definitions and tests.
4. Report each finding: severity, file:line, evidence, violated rule, proposed fix, and validation needed.
5. Separate verified correctness issues from performance hypotheses. If no findings, say so and list test gaps.
6. Stop for approval before any edits. Deployment is a separate action.

de-03.label: Naming rules
de-03.content:
# Naming requirements
Use uppercase descriptive object/column aliases. Fully qualify persisted objects with the approved HOL database and participant schema. Name the output by its grain (for example CUSTOMER_SPEND), not temp1. Do not rename unrelated objects.

de-03.label: Performance rules
de-03.content:
# Performance requirements
Select only needed columns. Apply explicit reporting windows. Verify join cardinality before aggregation and avoid duplicate fact rows. Compare results before/after. A style change is not proof of faster execution: require measured query profile evidence before claiming optimization. No expensive benchmarks in the live lab.

de-03.label: Parameterization rules
de-03.content:
# Parameterization requirements
Read target identifiers from validated configuration. Business dates must be explicit parameters, not hidden literals or CURRENT_DATE when reproducibility matters. Use bound values and validated identifiers. Never interpolate display names or untrusted text into SQL. Credentials belong in approved secret management, never code or reports.

Resolve these lowercase tool IDs against the active runtime before use. Do not silently broaden the allowlist if any are unavailable.

Read the assigned code, AGENTS.md and all hol-deployment-review resources. Review only the specified files. Do not execute SQL/shell, edit files, change grants, publish, or delegate further.
